title: Mixed affine pullback target unit normalization
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with independently chosen sheaf and module derived universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Put $F$ equal to tilde followed by the canonical chart restriction [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], $H=\Gamma_S$, $J=\Gamma_T$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], $K=g^*$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and $R$ scalar restriction. For a K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], put $C=F(P)$, $Q=Q(C)$ and $Y=J(K(C))$. There exists $b:R\Gamma_T(Lg^*Q)\cong Q(Y)$ such that $s_C;R\Gamma_S(\eta_g(Q));\mathrm{Leray}(Lg^*Q);R(b)=Q(H(\eta_K(C)));r_Y$, with the fixed normalized mixed Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso]. The exact formula, including complex functor factors, is recorded verbatim in lean.statement. No scalar extension comparison or hypothesis hc occurs.

proof.text: K-flat chart pullback is computed termwise. Tensor pullback/tilde base change identifies the pulled-back complex with an affine chart complex on T.
The sections unit is invertible on that chart complex; define b by sections of the pullback counit followed by its inverse.
Apply the pinned derived pullback unit factorization and sections-unit naturality, then the normalized Leray equation and its naturality at the counit; insert quotient factors.

theorem exists_mixedAffineSections_pullback_unit_normalization
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsAffine T] (g : T ⟶ S) :
    let F : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) :=
      tilde.functor Γ(S, ⊤) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ
    let H := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace
    let J := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace
    let K : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace) := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g
    let R := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} g.appTop.hom
    let d : F ⋙ H ⟶ F ⋙ K ⋙ J ⋙ R :=
      Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerLeft F
        (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit) H
    ∀ [F.Additive] [H.Additive] [J.Additive] [K.Additive]
      (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) ℤ)
      (_hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P),
    let C := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Q : DerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) := DerivedCategory.Q.obj C
    let Y := ((F ⋙ K ⋙ J).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    ∃ b : (schemeDerivedGlobalSections T).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Q) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj Y,
      mixedSectionsComplexUnit S C ≫
        (schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).map ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app Q) ≫
          (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj Q) ≫
            (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map b.hom =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((d.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).app P) ≫
        R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app Y
